'''Fallowan''' was an agricultural [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Sujimis sector/Legends|Sujimis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Fallowan was the site of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base [[Mission to Fallowan|infiltrated]] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Princess Leia and the Royal Ransom" />
